main_text.p: עלע עֲלָעָא Ch. Costa. Derivatum ex Hebraeo צלע, mutato ṣ in y, ut & alias.
עַלְעִיתָא Ch. Caussa, Occasio. Idem quod עְלָא, supra, Esth.1.16. in Targ.sec.
עָלֵק עֲלוּקָא Ch. Sanguisuga, ut Hebr.
עֻלְשִׁין עלש Ch. Herbae amarae, cum quibus agnus paschalis comedebatur. Quidam Nasturtium: alii Cicoreas interpretantur, Exod. 12. 8. in Targ. Jon. Cantic.2.9.
עמר ܥܡܪ Syr. Baptizari, intingi, ablui, abluere se. Ethp. ܐܬܥܡܪ Idem. Aphel ܐܐܡܪ Baptizare.
עמודא, עמוד Ch. & Syr. Columna, Statua. Plur. עמודין, עמודיא, ܥܡܘܕܐ.
עמא Ch. Obscurari, obscurum, obscuratum esse. Convenit cum Hebr. עמם.
עמיא עמי Ch. Obscurum. Plur.fem. עמין Lev.13.39.
עמט ܥܡܛ Syr. Caligo, Act.2.20. & 13.11. Idem quod Ch. אמטתא.
עמל ܥܡܠ Laborare, fatigari, defatigari. Hebr. עמל. Hinc & in Targ. דלא עמלת ביה In quo no laborasti, Jonae 4.10. Aphel ܐܥܡܠ Fatigare, Defatigare,

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac characters are only approximated in this transcription; the vocalised forms and pointing of the scan could not be reproduced reliably. Words marked by lost pointing are uncertain. Printed Hebrew or Syriac fragments beside Latin are rendered as closely as the scan allows.
